PSET_SPACEPROGRAMCOMMON.name: Pset_SpaceProgramCommon
PSET_SPACEPROGRAMCOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcSpaceProgram

properties.name: Location
properties.description: General description of the required location for the space (e.g. "third floor south")

properties.name: FunctionRequirement
properties.description: General description of the functional requirement for the space (in addition to the space name)

properties.name: SecurityRequirement
properties.description: General description of the security requirement for the space (in addition to the function requirement)

properties.name: PrivacyRequirement
properties.description: General description of the privacy requirement for the space (in addition to the security requirement)

properties.name: LightingRequirement
properties.description: General description of the lighting requirement for the space (e.g. "natural lighting required")

properties.name: FFETypeRequirement
properties.description: General description of the Furniture, Fixtures and Equipment requirement for this space.

properties.name: EmployeeType
properties.description: General description of the employee type that will occupy the space (e.g.  manager, programmer, secretary, etc.). The type classification depends on the company based terms for employee types.

properties.name: OccupancyType
properties.description: Occupancy type for this object.\X2\000A\X0\It is defined according to the presiding national building code.

properties.name: OccupancyNumber
properties.description: Maximum number of occupants for the designed usage of the space.

PSET_ACTUATORTYPECOMMON.name: Pset_ActuatorTypeCommon
PSET_ACTUATORTYPECOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Actuator type common attributes.

properties.name: FailPosition
properties.description: Specifies the required fail-safe position of the actuator.

properties.name: ManualOverride
properties.description: Identifies whether hand-operated operation is provided as an override (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE). Note that this value should be set to FALSE by default in the case of a Hand Operated Actuator.

properties.name: ConductorSheathMaterial

PSET_ELECTRICALCIRCUIT.description: Definition from IAI: A circuit supplies electrical devices with voltage and current.\X2\000A\X0\

PSET_ELECTRICALDEVICECOMMON.name: Pset_ElectricalDeviceCommon
PSET_ELECTRICALDEVICECOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: A means of collecting together all properties that are commonly used by electrical devices.

properties.name: NominalCurrent
properties.description: The maximum allowed current that a device is certified to handle.

properties.name: UsageCurrent
properties.description: The current that a device is actually handling or is calculated to be handling at a point in time.

properties.name: NominalVoltage
properties.description: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

properties.name: ElectricalDeviceNominalPower
properties.description: The output power rating that is certified for a device.

properties.name: NumberOfPoles
properties.description: The number of logical connections that can be made on an electrical device.

properties.name: HasProtectiveEarth
properties.description: Indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: NominalFrequencyRange
properties.description: The upper and lower limits of frequency for which the operation of the device is certified.

properties.name: PhaseAngle
properties.description: The angular difference between two waveforms of the same frequency

properties.name: IP_Code
properties.description: IEC 529 (1989) Classification of degrees of protection provided by enclosures (IP Code)

properties.name: InsulationStandardClass
properties.description: Insulation standard classes provides basic protection information against electric shock. Defines levels of insulation required in terms of constructional requirements (creepage and clearance distances) and electrical requirements (compliance with electric strength tests). Basic insulation is considered to be shorted under single fault conditions. The actual values required depend on the working voltage to which the insulation is subjected, as well as other factors. Also indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection.

properties.name: PhaseReference
properties.description: The phase identification used for the device electrical input. This should be the same phase identifier that is used for the conductor segment providing the electrical service to the device. In general, it is recommended that IEC recommendations for phase identification are used (L1, L2 etc.). However, other phase identifiers may be used such as by color (Red, Blue, Yellow) or by number (1, 2, 3) etc.

PSET_ELECTRICMOTORTYPECOMMON.name: Pset_ElectricMotorTypeCommon
PSET_ELECTRICMOTORTYPECOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Defines a particular type of engine that is a machine for converting electrical energy into mechanical energy. Note that in cases where a close coupled or monobloc pump or close coupled fan is being driven by the motor, the motor may itself be considered to be directly part of the pump or fan. In this case , motor information may need to be specified directly at the pump or fan and not througfh separate motor/motor connection entities.

properties.name: MotorEnclosureType
properties.description: A list of the available types of motor enclosure from which that required may be selected.

properties.name: IsGuarded
properties.description: Indication of whether the motor enclosure is guarded (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE)

properties.name: HasPartWinding

properties.name: FrameSize

properties.name: ElectricMotorEfficiency

properties.name: StartCurrentFactor

properties.name: LockedRotorCurrent
properties.description: Input current when a motor armature is energized but not rotating.

properties.name: MaximumPowerOutput

PSET_LAMPTYPECOMMON.name: Pset_LampTypeCommon
PSET_LAMPTYPECOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: A lamp is a component within a light fixture that is designed to emit light. \X2\000A000A\X0\History: Name changed from Pset_LampEmitterTypeCommon in IFC 2x3.\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: ContributedLuminousFlux
properties.description: Luminous flux is a photometric measure of radiant flux, i.e. the volume of light emitted from a light source. Luminous flux is measured either for the interior as a whole or for a part of the interior (partial luminous flux for a solid angle). All other photometric parameters are derivatives of luminous flux. Luminous flux is measured in lumens (lm). The luminous flux is given as a nominal value for each lamp.

properties.name: LightEmitterNominalPower
properties.description: Light emitter nominal power.

properties.name: LampMaintenanceFactor
properties.description: Non recoverable losses of luminous flux of a lamp due to lamp depreciation; i.e. the decreasing of light output of a luminaire due to aging and dirt.

properties.name: LampBallastType
properties.description: The type of ballast used to stabilise gas discharge by limiting the current during operation and to deliver the necessary striking voltage for starting. Ballasts are needed to operate Discharge Lamps such as Fluorescent, Compact Fluorescent, High-pressure Mercury, Metal Halide and High-pressure Sodium Lamps. \X2\000A\X0\Magnetic ballasts are chokes which limit the current passing through a lamp connected in series on the principle of self-induction. The resultant current and power are decisive for the efficient operation of the lamp. A specially designed ballast is required for every type of lamp to comply with lamp rating in terms of Luminous Flux, Color Appearance and service life. The two types of magnetic ballasts for fluorescent lamps are KVG Conventional   (EC-A series) and VVG Low-loss ballasts (EC-B series). Low-loss ballasts have a higher efficiency, which means reduced ballast losses and a lower thermal load. Electronic ballasts are used to run fluorescent lamps at high frequencies (approx. 35 - 40 kHz).\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: LampCompensationType
properties.description: Identifies the form of compensation used for power factor correction and radio suppression.

properties.name: ColorAppearance
properties.description: In both the DIN and CIE standards, artificial light sources are classified in terms of their color appearance. To the human eye they all appear to be white; the difference can only be detected by direct comparison. Visual performance is not directly affected by differences in color appearance.

properties.name: Spectrum
properties.description: The spectrum of radiation describes its composition with regard to wavelength. Light, for example, as the portion of electromagnetic radiation that is visible to the human eye, is radiation with wavelengths in the range of approx. 380 to 780 nm (1 nm = 10 m). The corresponding range of colours varies from violet to indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange, and red. These colours form a continuous spectrum, in which the various spectral sectors merge into each other.

properties.name: ColorTemperature
properties.description: The color temperature of any source of radiation is defined as the temperature (in Kelvin) of a black-body or Planckian radiator whose radiation has the same chromaticity as the source of radiation. Often the values are only approximate color temperatures as the black-body radiator cannot emit radiation of every chromaticity value. The color temperatures of the commonest artificial light sources range from less than 3000K (warm white) to 4000K (intermediate) and over 5000K (daylight).

properties.name: ColorRenderingIndex
properties.description: The CRI indicates how well a light source renders eight standard colors compared to perfect reference lamp with the same color temperature. The CRI scale ranges from 1 to 100, with 100 representing perfect rendering properties.

PSET_PROTECTIVEDEVICETYPECIRCUITBREAKER.description: Definition from IEC 441-14-20: A circuit breaker is a mechanical switching device capable of making, carrying, and breaking currents under normal circuit conditions and also making, carrying for a specified time and breaking, current under specified abnormal circuit conditions such as those of short circuit.

PSET_PROTECTIVEDEVICETYPECOMMON.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeCommon

properties.name: CutOffCurrent

properties.name: MaximumRatedVoltage

PSET_PROTECTIVEDEVICETYPEFUSEDISCONNECTO.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeFuseDisconnector
PSET_PROTECTIVEDEVICETYPEFUSEDISCONNECTO.description: Definition from IAI: A device that will electrically open the circuit after a period of prolonged, abnormal current flow.

PSET_SWITCHINGDEVICETYPESTARTER.name: Pset_SwitchingDeviceTypeStarter
PSET_SWITCHINGDEVICETYPESTARTER.description: Definition from IAI: A starter is a switch which in the closed position controls the application of power to an electrical device.

properties.name: StarterType
properties.description: A list of the available types of starter from which that required may be selected where:\X2\000A000A\X0\AutoTransformer - A starter for an induction motor which uses for starting one or more reduced voltages derived from an auto transformer. (IEC 441-14-45)\X2\000A\X0\Manual - A starter in which the force for closing the main contacts is provided exclusively by manual energy. properties.description: Nominal or quoted length, measured along the y-axis of the local coordinate system of the object, of the body of the object.

properties.name: NominalBodyDepth
properties.description: Nominal or quoted length, measured along the z-axis of the local coordinate system of the object, of the body of the object.

properties.name: InletConnectionSize
properties.description: Size of the inlet connection.

properties.name: OutletConnectionSize
properties.description: Size of the outlet connection.

properties.name: CoverLength
properties.description: The length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system or the radius (in the case of a circular shape in plan) of the cover of the oil interceptor.

properties.name: CoverWidth
properties.description: The length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system of the cover of the oil interceptor.

properties.name: CoverMaterial
properties.description: Material from which the cover is constructed.

PSET_WASTETERMINALTYPEPETROLINTERCEPTOR.name: Pset_WasteTerminalTypePetrolInterceptor
PSET_WASTETERMINALTYPEPETROLINTERCEPTOR.description: Definition from IAI: Two or more chambers with inlet and outlet pipes arranged to allow petrol/gasoline collected on the surface of water drained into them to evaporate through ventilating pipes.

properties.name: BodyMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the object is constructed.

properties.name: NominalBodyLength
properties.description: Nominal or quoted length, measured along the x-axis of the local coordinate system of the object, of the body of the object.

properties.name: NominalBodyWidth
properties.description: Nominal or quoted length, measured along the y-axis of the local coordinate system of the object, of the body of the object.

properties.name: NominalBodyDepth
properties.description: Nominal or quoted =length, measured along the z-axis of the local coordinate system of the object, of the body of the object.

properties.name: InletConnectionSize
properties.description: Size of the inlet connection.

properties.name: OutletConnectionSize
properties.description: Size of the outlet connection.

properties.name: CoverLength
properties.description: The length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system or the radius (in the case of a circular shape in plan) of the cover of the oil interceptor.

properties.name: CoverWidth
properties.description: The length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system of the cover of the oil interceptor.

properties.name: CoverMaterial
properties.description: Material from which the cover is constructed.

properties.name: VentilatingPipeSize
properties.description: Size of the ventilating pipe(s)

PSET_WASTETERMINALTYPEROOFDRAIN.name: Pset_WasteTerminalTypeRoofDrain
PSET_WASTETERMINALTYPEROOFDRAIN.description: Definition from IAI: Pipe fitting, set into the roof, that collects rainwater for discharge into the rainwater system.

properties.name: NominalBodyLength
properties.description: Nominal or quoted length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system or the radius (in the case of a circular shape in plan) of the drain.

properties.name: NominalBodyWidth
properties.description: Nominal or quoted length measured along the y-axis in the local coordinate system of the drain.

properties.name: NominalBodyDepth
properties.description: Nominal or quoted length measured along the z-axis in the local coordinate system of the drain.

properties.name: BodyMaterial
properties.description: The primary material used to construct the object

properties.name: OutletConnectionSize
properties.description: Size of the outlet connection from the object

properties.name: CoverLength
properties.description: The length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system or the radius (in the case of a circular shape in plan) of the cover of the drain.

properties.name: CoverWidth
properties.description: The length measured along the y-axis in the local coordinate system of the cover of the  drain.

properties.name: CoverMaterial
properties.description: Material from which the cover or grating is constructed.

PSET_WASTETERMINALTYPEWASTEDISPOSALUNIT.name: Pset_WasteTerminalTypeWasteDisposalUnit
PSET_WASTETERMINALTYPEWASTEDISPOSALUNIT.description: Definition from IAI: Electrically operated device that reduces kitchen or other waste into fragments small enough to be flushed into a drainage system.

properties.name: DrainConnectionSize
properties.description: Size of the drain connection inlet to the waste disposal unit.

properties.name: OutletConnectionSize
properties.description: Size of the outlet connection from the waste disposal unit

properties.name: NominalDepth
properties.description: Nominal or quoted depth of the object measured from the inlet drain connection to the base of the unit.

PSET_WASTETERMINALTYPEWASTETRAP.name: Pset_WasteTerminalTypeWasteTrap
PSET_WASTETERMINALTYPEWASTETRAP.description: Definition from IAI: Pipe fitting, set adjacent to a sanitary terminal, that retains liquid to prevent the passage of foul air.

properties.name: WasteTrapType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of trap from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: OutletConnectionSize
properties.description: Size of the outlet connection from the object

properties.name: InletConnectionSize
properties.description: Size of the inlet connection(s), where used, of the inlet connections.\X2\000A000A\X0\Note that all inlet connections are assumed to be the same size.

PSET_BUILDINGCOMMON.name: Pset_BuildingCommon
PSET_BUILDINGCOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuilding. Please note that several building attributes are handled directly at the IfcBuilding instance, the building number (or short name) by IfcBuilding.Name, the building name (or long name) by IfcBuilding.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcBuilding.Description. Actual building quantities, like building perimeter, building area and building volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and the building classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference.

properties.name: BuildingID
properties.description: A unique identifier assigned to a building. A temporary identifier is initially assigned at the time of making a planning application. This temporary identifier is changed to a permanent identifier when the building is registered into a statutory buildings and properties database.

properties.name: IsPermanentID
properties.description: Indicates whether the identity assigned to a building is permanent (= TRUE) or temporary (=FALSE)

properties.name: MainFireUse
properties.description: Main fire use for the building which is assigned from the fire use classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

properties.name: AncillaryFireUse
properties.description: Ancillary fire use for the building which is assigned from the fire use classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

properties.name: SprinklerProtection
properties.description: Indication whether this object is sprinkler protected (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: SprinklerProtectionAutomatic
properties.description: Indication whether this object has an automatic sprinkler protection (TRUE) or not (FALSE).\X2\000A\X0\It should only be given, if the property "SprinklerProtection" is set to TRUE.

properties.name: OccupancyType
properties.description: Occupancy type for this object.\X2\000A\X0\It is defined according to the presiding national building code.

properties.name: GrossPlannedArea
properties.description: Total planned area for the building  Used for programming the building.

properties.name: NumberOfStoreys
properties.description: Captures the number of storeys within a building for those cases where the IfcBuildingStorey entity is not used. Note that if IfcBuilingStorey is asserted and the number of storeys in a building can be determined from it, then this approach should be used in preference to setting a property for the number of storeys.

properties.name: YearOfConstruction
properties.description: Year of construction of this building, including expected year of completion.

properties.name: IsLandmarked
properties.description: This builing is listed as a historic building (TRUE), or not (FALSE), or unknown.

PSET_BUILDINGELEMENTPROXYCOMMON.name: Pset_BuildingElementProxyCommon
PSET_BUILDINGELEMENTPROXYCOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuildingElementProxy.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

PSET_BUILDINGSTOREYCOMMON.name: Pset_BuildingStoreyCommon
PSET_BUILDINGSTOREYCOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuildingStorey. Please note that several building attributes are handled directly at the IfcBuildingStorey instance, the building storey number (or short name) by IfcBuildingStorey.Name, the building storey name (or long name) by IfcBuildingStorey.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcBuildingStorey.Description. Actual building storey quantities, like building storey perimeter, building storey area and building storey volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and the building storey classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference. \X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: EntranceLevel
properties.description: Indication whether this building storey is an entrance level to the building (TRUE), or (FALSE) if otherwise.

properties.name: AboveGround
properties.description: Indication whether this building storey is fully above ground (TRUE), or below ground (FALSE), or partially above and below ground (UNKNOWN) - as in sloped terrain.

properties.name: SprinklerProtection
properties.description: Indication whether this object is sprinkler protected (true) or not (false).

properties.name: SprinklerProtectionAutomatic
properties.description: Indication whether this object has an automatic sprinkler protection (true) or not (false).\X2\000A\X0\It should only be given, if the property "SprinklerProtection" is set to TRUE.

properties.name: GrossAreaPlanned
properties.description: Total planned area for the building storey. Used for programming the building storey.

properties.name: NetAreaPlanned
properties.description: Total planned net area for the building storey. Used for programming the building storey.

PSET_BUILDINGUSE.name: Pset_BuildingUse
PSET_BUILDINGUSE.description: Definition from IAI: Provides information on on the real estate context of the building of interest both current and anticipated.

properties.name: MarketCategory
properties.description: Category of use e.g. residential, commercial, recreation etc.

properties.name: MarketSubCategory
properties.description: Subset of category of use e.g. multi-family, 2 bedroom, low rise

properties.name: PlanningControlStatus
properties.description: Label of zoning category or class, or planning control category for the site or facility.

properties.name: NarrativeText
properties.description: Added information relating to the adjacent building use that is not appropriate to the general descriptive text associated with an entity through the inherited IfcRoot.Description

properties.name: VacancyRateInCategoryNow
properties.description: Percentage of vacancy found in the particular category currently

properties.name: TenureModesAvailableNow
properties.description: A list of the tenure modes that are currently available expressed in terms of IfcLabel

properties.name: MarketSubCategoriesAvailableNow
properties.description: A list of the sub categories of property that are currently available expressed in terms of IfcLabel

properties.name: RentalRatesInCategoryNow
properties.description: Range of the cost rates for property currently available in the required category.

properties.name: VacancyRateInCategoryFuture
properties.description: Percentage of vacancy found in the particular category expected in the future

properties.name: TenureModesAvailableFuture
properties.description: A list of the tenure modes that are expected to be available in the future expressed in terms of IfcLabel

properties.name: MarketSubCategoriesAvailableFuture
properties.description: A list of the sub categories of property that are expected to be available in the future expressed in terms of IfcLabel

properties.name: RentalRatesInCategoryFuture
properties.description: Range of the cost rates for property expected to be available in the future in the required category.

PSET_BUILDINGUSEADJACENT.name: Pset_BuildingUseAdjacent
PSET_BUILDINGUSEADJACENT.description: Definition from IAI: Provides information on adjacent buildings and their uses to enable their impact on the building of interest to be determined. Note that for each instance of the property set used, where there is an existence of risk, there will be an instance of the property set Pset_Risk (q.v)

properties.name: MarketCategory
properties.description: Category of use e.g. residential, commercial, recreation etc.

properties.name: MarketSubCategory
properties.description: Subset of category of use e.g. multi-family, 2 bedroom, low rise

properties.name: PlanningControlStatus
properties.description: Label of zoning category or class, or planning control category for the site or facility.

properties.name: NarrativeText
properties.description: Added information relating to the adjacent building use that is not appropriate to the general descriptive text associated with an entity through the inherited IfcRoot.Description

PSET_BUILDINGWATERSTORAGE.name: Pset_BuildingWaterStorage
PSET_BUILDINGWATERSTORAGE.description: The basic set of properties that are used for determining the water requirements for a building.\X2\000A\X0\Typically, this property set is expected to be used in conjunction with IfcBuilding.

properties.name: WaterStorageRatePerPerson
properties.description: The volume of domestic water that needs to be stored per person.

properties.name: OneDayPotableWater
properties.description: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply water to the building for human use for one day in the event of water supply failure.

properties.name: OneDayEssentialWater
properties.description: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply water to the building for uninterrupted water supply to essential areas for one day in the event of water supply failure. An essential area is considered to be a part of a building carrying out a critical function and that is unable to operate in the intended manner without a water supply.

properties.name: OneDayCoolingTowerMakeupWater
properties.description: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply make up water to the cooling towers in a building for one day in the event of water supply failure.

properties.name: OneDayProcessOrProductionWater
properties.description: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply water for process or production requirements in a building for one day in the event of water supply failure.

PSET_COVERINGCEILING.name: Pset_CoveringCeiling
PSET_COVERINGCEILING.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcCovering with the PredefinedType set to CEILING.

properties.name: FragilityRating
properties.description: The level of fragility of the ceiling.\X2\000A\X0\It is giving according to the national building code.

properties.name: Permeability
properties.description: Ratio of the permeability of the ceiling.\X2\000A\X0\The ration can be used to indicate an open ceiling (that enables identification of whether ceiling construction should be considered as impeding distribution of sprinkler water, light etc. from installations within the ceiling area) .

properties.name: TileLength
properties.description: Length of ceiling tiles. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: TileWidth
properties.description: Width of ceiling tiles. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

PSET_COVERINGCOMMON.name: Pset_CoveringCommon
PSET_COVERINGCOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcCovering.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

properties.name: FireRating
properties.description: Fire rating for this object.\X2\000A\X0\It is given according to the national fire safety classification.

properties.name: AcousticRating
properties.description: Acoustic rating for this object.\X2\000A\X0\It is giving according to the national building code. It indicates the sound transmission resistance of this object by an index ration (instead of providing full sound absorbtion values).

properties.name: FlammabilityRating
properties.description: Flammability Rating for this object.\X2\000A\X0\It is given according to the national building code that governs the rating of flammability for materials.

properties.name: FragilityRating
properties.description: Indication on the fragility of the covering (e.g., under fire conditions).  It is given according to the national building code that might provide a classification for fragility.

properties.name: SurfaceSpreadOfFlame
properties.description: Indication on how the flames spread around the surface,\X2\000A\X0\It is given according to the national building code that governs the fire behaviour for materials.

properties.name: Material
properties.description: Main material of the covering, it should only be given, if no IfcMaterial class is assigned to the IfcCovering instance.

properties.name: Combustible
properties.description: Indication whether the object is made from combustible material (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: TotalThickness
properties.description: Thickness of the covering, The thickness information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: Finish
properties.description: Finish selection for this object.\X2\000A\X0\Here specification of the surface finish for informational purposes

PSET_COVERINGFLOORING.name: Pset_CoveringFlooring
PSET_COVERINGFLOORING.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcCovering with the PredefinedType set to FLOORING.

properties.name: HasNonSkidSurface
properties.description: Indication whether the surface finish is designed to prevent slippery (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: HasAntiStaticSurface
properties.description: Indication whether the surface finish is designed to prevent electrostatic charge (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

PSET_DRAUGHTING.name: Pset_Draughting
PSET_DRAUGHTING.description: Definition from IAI: Property set to capture layer and colour as a quick win implementation within IFC2x platform to enable more efficient exchange of 3D building models.\X2\000A\X0\NOTE: With implementation of the IFC2x2 capabilities defined in the presentation resources (IfcPresentationLayerAssignment, IfcCurveStyle) the use of this property set may become obsolete.

properties.name: LayerName
properties.description: Identifier of the layer name within the sending application.

PSET_ELEMENTSHADING.name: Pset_ElementShading
PSET_ELEMENTSHADING.description: Definition from IAI: Shading device properties associated with an element that represents a shading device, e.g. an IfcBuildingElementProxy or any other building element.\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: ShadingDeviceType
properties.description: Specifies the type of shading device.

properties.name: Azimuth
properties.description: Azimuth of the element as derived from the placement of the element shape, by convention: North = 0' and measurement is done clockwise (I.e. east = 90', if unit is grad). The calculation procedure will be specific for each type of element.  In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the azimuth property, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: Inclination
properties.description: Inclination of the element as derived from the placement of the element shape, by convention: Vertical = 0', horizontal = 90', if unit is grad). The calculation procedure will be specific for each type of element.  In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the azimuth property, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: TiltRange
properties.description: The minimum and maximum angles of possible tilt defined in the plane perpendicular to the extrusion axis (X-Axis of the local placement). The angle shall be measured from the orientation of the Z-Axis in the local placement.

properties.name: AverageSolarTransmittance
properties.description: Overall or average ratio of the solar flux transmitted through a body to that incident upon it.

properties.name: AverageVisibleTransmittance
properties.description: Overall or average ratio of the visible spectral flux transmitted through a body to that incident upon it.

properties.name: Reflectance
properties.description: The ratio of reflected power to incident power.

properties.name: Roughness
properties.description: A measure of the vertical deviations of the surface.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: The color of the surface.

PSET_OPENINGELEMENTCOMMON.name: Pset_OpeningElementCommon
PSET_OPENINGELEMENTCOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcOpeningElement.\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

properties.name: Purpose
properties.description: Indication of the purpose for that opening, e.g. 'ventilation', 'access', etc.

properties.name: FireExit
properties.description: Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE).\X2\000A\X0\Here whether the space (in case of e.g., a corridor) is designed to serve as an exit space, e.g., for fire escape purposes.

properties.name: ProtectedOpening
properties.description: Indication whether the opening is considered to be protected under fire safety considerations. If (TRUE) it counts as a protected opening under the applicable building code, (FALSE) otherwise.

properties.name: ParallelJambs
properties.description: Indicated, whether the jambs of an opening in a curved building element are intended to be parallel (TRUE) or are radial (FALSE). Radial means, that the extension of the jambs are rays through the axis of the revolution forming the curved building element.

PSET_QUANTITYTAKEOFF.name: Pset_QuantityTakeOff
PSET_QUANTITYTAKEOFF.description: Definition from IAI: Description of quantities for work items to be exchanged in addition to the IfcElementQuantity\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type of quantity, e.g. linking back to a macro name, etc.

properties.name: LocalContext
properties.description: Local context information for the take-off quantity, if multiple information items are passed, then the property shall be indexed, e.g. LocalContext1, LocalContext2, \X2\2026\X0\

PSET_SITECOMMON.name: Pset_SiteCommon
PSET_SITECOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSite. Please note that several site attributes are handled directly at the IfcSite instance, the site number (or short name) by IfcSite.Name, the site name (or long name) by IfcSite.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcSite.Description. The land title number is also given as an explicit attribute IfcSite.LandTitleNumber. Actual site quantities, like site perimeter, site area and site volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and site classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference. The global positioning of the site in terms of Northing and Easting and height above sea level datum is given by IfcSite.RefLongitude, IfcSite.RefLatitude, IfcSite.RefElevation and the postal address by IfcSite.SiteAddress.

properties.name: BuildableArea
properties.description: The area of utilization expressed as a minimum value and a maximum value  - according to local building codes.

properties.name: TotalArea
properties.description: Total area of the site - masured according to local building codes.

properties.name: BuildingHeightLimit
properties.description: Calculated maximum height of buildings on this site - according to local building codes.

PSET_SPACECOMMON.name: Pset_SpaceCommon
PSET_SPACECOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSpace. Please note that several space attributes are handled directly at the IfcSpace instance, the space number (or short name) by IfcSpace.Name, the space name (or long name) by IfcSpace:LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcSpace.Description. Actual space quantities, like space perimeter, space area and space volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and space classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference. The level above zero (relative to the building) for the slab row construction is provided by the IfcBuildingStorey.Elevation, the level above zero (relative to the building) for the floor finish is provided by the IfcSpace.ElevationWithFlooring.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

properties.name: Category
properties.description: Category of space usage or utilization of the area. It is defined according to the presiding national building code.

properties.name: FloorCovering
properties.description: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.

properties.name: WallCovering
properties.description: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.

properties.name: CeilingCovering
properties.description: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.

properties.name: SkirtingBoard
properties.description: Label to indicate the material or construction of the skirting board around the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.

properties.name: GrossPlannedArea
properties.description: Total planned area for the space. Used for programming the space.

properties.name: PubliclyAccessible
properties.description: Indication whether this space (in case of e.g., a toilet) is designed to serve as a publicly accessible space, e.g., for a public toilet (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: HandicapAccessible
properties.description: Indication whether this space (in case of e.g., a toilet) is designed to serve as an accessible space for handicapped people, e.g., for a public toilet (TRUE) or not (FALSE). This information is often used to declare the need for access for the disabled and for special design requirements of this space.

properties.name: ConcealedFlooring
properties.description: Indication whether this space is declared to be a concealed flooring (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A concealed flooring is normally meant to be the space beneath a raised floor.

properties.name: ConcealedCeiling
properties.description: Indication whether this space is declared to be a concealed ceiling (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A concealed ceiling is normally meant to be the space between a slab and a suspended ceiling.

PSET_SPACEFIRESAFETYREQUIREMENTS.name: Pset_SpaceFireSafetyRequirements
PSET_SPACEFIRESAFETYREQUIREMENTS.description: Definition from IAI: Properties related to fire protection of spaces that apply to the occurrences of IfcSpace or IfcZone.

properties.name: MainFireUse
properties.description: Main fire use for the space which is assigned from the fire use classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

properties.name: AncillaryFireUse
properties.description: Ancillary fire use for the space which is assigned from the fire use classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

properties.name: FireRiskFactor
properties.description: Fire Risk factor assigned to the space according to local building regulations.

properties.name: FireHazardFactor
properties.description: Fire hazard code of the space. The coding depends on the national fire safety regulations.

properties.name: FlammableStorage
properties.description: Indication whether the space is intended to serve as a storage of flammable material (which is regarded as such by the presiding building code. (TRUE) indicates yes, (FALSE) otherwise.

properties.name: FireExit
properties.description: Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE).\X2\000A\X0\Here whether the space (in case of e.g., a corridor) is designed to serve as an exit space, e.g., for fire escape purposes.

properties.name: SprinklerProtection
properties.description: Indication whether the space is sprinkler protected (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: SprinklerProtectionAutomatic
properties.description: Indication whether the space has an automatic sprinkler protection (TRUE) or not (FALSE).\X2\000A\X0\It should only be given, if the property "SprinklerProtection" is set to TRUE.

properties.name: AirPressurization
properties.description: Indication whether the space is required to have pressurized air (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

PSET_SPACELIGHTINGREQUIREMENTS.name: Pset_SpaceLightingRequirements
PSET_SPACELIGHTINGREQUIREMENTS.description: Definition from IAI: Properties related to the lighting requirements that apply to the occurrences of IfcSpace or IfcZone. This includes the required artificial lighting, illuminance, etc.

properties.name: ArtificialLighting
properties.description: Indication whether this space  requires artificial lighting (as natural lighting would be not sufficient). (TRUE) indicates yes (FALSE) otherwise.

properties.name: Illuminance
properties.description: Required average illuminance value for this space.

PSET_SPACEOCCUPANCYREQUIREMENTS.name: Pset_SpaceOccupancyRequirements
PSET_SPACEOCCUPANCYREQUIREMENTS.description: Definition from IAI: Properties concerning work activities occurring or expected to occur within one or a set of similar spatial structure elements.

properties.name: OccupancyType
properties.description: Occupancy type for this object. It is defined according to the presiding national building code.

properties.name: OccupancyNumber
properties.description: Number of people required for the activity assigned to this space.

properties.name: OccupancyNumberPeak
properties.description: Maximal number of people required for the activity assigned to this space in peak time.

properties.name: OccupancyTimePerDay
properties.description: The amount of time during the day that the activity is required within this space.

properties.name: AreaPerOccupant
properties.description: Design occupancy loading for this type of usage assigned to this space.

properties.name: MinimumHeadroom
properties.description: Headroom required for the activity assigned to this space.

properties.name: IsOutlookDesirable
properties.description: An indication of whether the outlook is desirable (set TRUE) or not (set FALSE)

PSET_SPACEPARKING.name: Pset_SpaceParking
PSET_SPACEPARKING.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSpace which have an attribute value for ObjectType = 'Parking'. NOTE: Modified in IFC 2x3, properties ParkingUse and ParkingUnits added.

properties.name: HandicapAccessible
properties.description: Indication that this object is designed to be accessible by the handicapped. \X2\000A\X0\It is giving according to the requirements of the national building code.

properties.name: ParkingUse
properties.description: Identifies the type of transporation for which the parking space is designed. Values are not predefined but might include car, compact car, motorcycle, bicycle, truck, bus etc.

properties.name: ParkingUnits
properties.description: Indicates the number of transporation units of the type specified by the property ParkingUse that may be accommodated within the space. Generally, this value should default to 1 unit. However, where the parking space is for motorcycles or bicycles, provision may be made for more than one unit in the space.

PSET_SPACEPARKINGAISLE.name: Pset_SpaceParkingAisle
PSET_SPACEPARKINGAISLE.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSpace which have an attribute value for ObjectType = 'ParkingAisle'.

properties.name: IsOneWay
properties.description: Indicates whether the parking aisle is designed for oneway traffic (TRUE) or twoway traffic (FALSE).

PSET_SPACETHERMALREQUIREMENTS.name: Pset_SpaceThermalRequirements
PSET_SPACETHERMALREQUIREMENTS.description: Definition from IAI: Properties related to the comfort requirements for thermal and other  thermal related performances of spaces that apply to the occurrences of IfcSpace or IfcZone. This includes the required design temperature, humidity, and air conditioning.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureMax
properties.description: Temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureMin
properties.description: Minimal temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point. If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureSummerMax
properties.description: Maximal temperature of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureSummerMin
properties.description: Minimal temperature of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureWinterMax
properties.description: Maximal temperature of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period, that is required from user/designer view point.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureWinterMin
properties.description: Minimal temperature of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period, that is required from user/designer view point.

properties.name: SpaceHumidity
properties.description: Humidity of the space or zone that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space humidity requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

properties.name: SpaceHumiditySummer
properties.description: Humidity of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point.

properties.name: SpaceHumidityWinter
properties.description: Humidity of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period that is required from user/designer view point.

properties.name: DiscontinuedHeating

properties.name: NaturalVentilation
properties.description: Indication whether the space is required to have natural ventilation (TRUE) or mechanical ventilation (FALSE).

properties.name: NaturalVentilationRate
properties.description: Indication of the requirement of a particular natural air ventilation rate, given in air changes per hour.

properties.name: MechanicalVentilationRate
properties.description: Indication of the requirement of a particular mechanical air ventilation rate, given in air changes per hour.

properties.name: AirConditioning
properties.description: Indication whether this space requires air conditioning provided (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: AirConditioningCentral
properties.description: Indication whether the space  requires a central air conditioning provided (TRUE) or not (FALSE).\X2\000A\X0\It should only be given, if the property "AirConditioning" is set to TRUE.

properties.description: Name of the gas by which the gap between two glass layers is filled. It is given for information purposes only.

properties.name: Reflectivity

properties.name: BeamRadiationTransmittance

properties.name: ThermalTransmittanceSummer

properties.name: ThermalTransmittanceWinter
properties.description: Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.\X2\000A\X0\Winter thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value)
