PSET_FLOWSTORAGEDEVICETANK.description: Definition from IAI: Properties that relate to an instance of a flow storage device that is typed as a tank. Note that a partial tank may be considered as a compartment within a compartmentalized tank.

properties.name: TankComposition
properties.description: Defines the level of element composition where:\X2\000A000A\X0\COMPLEX = A set of elementary units aggregated together to fulfill the overall  required purpose.\X2\000A\X0\ELEMENT = A single elementary unit that may exist of itself or as an aggregation of partial units..\X2\000A\X0\PARTIAL

properties.name: HasLadder
properties.description: Indication of whether the tank is provided with a ladder (set TRUE) for access to the top. If no ladder is provided then value is set FALSE.\X2\000A000A\X0\Note: No indication is given of the type of ladder (gooseneck etc.)

properties.name: HasVisualIndicator
properties.description: Indication of whether the tank is provided with a visual indicator (set TRUE) that shows the water level in the tank. If no visual indicator is provided then value is set FALSE.

PSET_FLOWTERMINALAIRTERMINAL.name: Pset_FlowTerminalAirTerminal
PSET_FLOWTERMINALAIRTERMINAL.description: Definition from IAI: Air terminal occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowTerminal.\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: AirflowType
properties.description: Enumeration defining the functional type of air flow through the terminal.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Location  (a single type of diffuser can be used for multiple locations); high means close to ceiling.

PSET_OUTSIDEDESIGNCRITERIA.name: Pset_OutsideDesignCriteria
PSET_OUTSIDEDESIGNCRITERIA.description: Definition from IAI: Outside air conditions used as the basis for calculating thermal loads at peak conditions, as well as the weather data location from which these conditions were obtained. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0.

properties.name: HeatingDryBulb
properties.description: Outside dry bulb temperature for heating design

properties.name: HeatingWetBulb
properties.description: Outside wet bulb temperature for heating design

properties.name: HeatingDesignDay
properties.description: The month, day and time that has been selected for the heating design calculations.

properties.name: CoolingDryBulb
properties.description: Outside dry bulb temperature for cooling design

properties.name: CoolingWetBulb
properties.description: Outside wet bulb temperature for cooling design

properties.name: CoolingDesignDay
properties.description: The month, day  and time that has been selected for the cooling design calculations.

properties.name: WeatherDataStation
properties.description: The site weather data station description or reference to the data source from which weather data was obtained for use in calculations.

properties.name: WeatherDataDate
properties.description: The date for which the weather data was gathered.

properties.name: BuildingThermalExposure
properties.description: The thermal exposure expected by the building based on surrounding site conditions.

properties.name: PrevailingWindDirection
properties.description: The prevailing wind angle direction measured from True North (0 degrees) in a clockwise direction.

properties.name: PrevailingWindVelocity
properties.description: The design wind velocity coming from the direction specified by the PrevailingWindDirection attribute.

PSET_SPACETHERMALDESIGN.name: Pset_SpaceThermalDesign
PSET_SPACETHERMALDESIGN.description: Definition from IAI: Space or zone HVAC design requirements. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0 (Pset_SpaceHvacInformation); renamed to Pset_SpaceThermalDesign and revised in IFC2x2.

properties.name: CoolingDesignAirflow
properties.description: The air flowrate required during the peak cooling conditions.

properties.name: HeatingDesignAirflow
properties.description: The air flowrate required during the peak heating conditions, but could also be determined by minimum ventilation requirement or minimum air change requirements.

properties.name: TotalSensibleHeatGain
properties.description: The total sensible heat or energy gained by the space during the peak cooling conditions.

properties.name: TotalHeatGain
properties.description: The total amount of heat or energy gained by the space at the time of the space's peak cooling conditions.

properties.name: TotalHeatLoss
properties.description: The total amount of heat or energy lost by the space at the time of the space's peak heating conditions.

properties.name: CoolingDryBulb
properties.description: Inside dry bulb temperature for cooling design

properties.name: CoolingRelativeHumidity
properties.description: Inside relative humidity for cooling design.

properties.name: HeatingDryBulb
properties.description: Inside dry bulb temperature for heating design

properties.name: HeatingRelativeHumidity
properties.description: Inside relative humidity for heating design.

properties.name: VentilationAirFlowrate
properties.description: Ventilation outside air requirement for the space.

properties.name: ExhaustAirFlowrate
properties.description: Design exhaust air flow rate for the space.

properties.name: CeilingRAPlenum
properties.description: Ceiling plenum used for return air or not. TRUE = Yes, FALSE = No.

properties.name: BoundaryAreaHeatLoss
properties.description: Heat loss per unit area for the boundary object. This is a design input value for use in the absence of calculated load data.

PSET_THERMALLOADAGGREGATE.name: Pset_ThermalLoadAggregate
PSET_THERMALLOADAGGREGATE.description: Definition from IAI: The aggregated thermal loads experienced by one or many spaces, zones, or buildings. This aggregate thermal load information is typically addressed by a system or plant. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0 (Pset_AggregateLoadInformation); renamed Pset_ThermalLoadAggregate in IFC2x2.

properties.name: TotalCoolingLoad
properties.description: The peak total cooling load for the building, zone or space.

properties.name: TotalHeatingLoad
properties.description: The peak total heating load for the building, zone or space.

properties.name: LightingDiversity
properties.description: Lighting diversity.

properties.name: InfiltrationDiversitySummer
properties.description: Diversity factor for Summer infiltration.

properties.name: InfiltrationDiversityWinter
properties.description: Diversity factor for Winter infiltration.

properties.name: ApplianceDiversity
properties.description: Diversity of appliance load.

properties.name: LoadSafetyFactor
properties.description: Load safety factor.

PSET_THERMALLOADDESIGNCRITERIA.name: Pset_ThermalLoadDesignCriteria
PSET_THERMALLOADDESIGNCRITERIA.description: Definition from IAI: Building thermal load design data that are used for calculating thermal loads in a space or building. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0 (Pset_LoadDesignCriteria); renamed Pset_ThermalLoadDesignCriteria in IFC2x2.

properties.name: OccupancyDiversity
properties.description: Diversity factor that may be applied to the number of people in the space.

properties.name: OutsideAirPerPerson
properties.description: Design quantity of outside air to be provided per person in the space.

properties.name: ReceptacleLoadIntensity
properties.description: Average power use intensity of appliances and other non-HVAC equipment.in the space per unit area.(PowerMeasure/IfcAreaMeasure)

properties.name: AppliancePercentLoadToRadiant
properties.description: Percent of sensible load to radiant heat.

properties.name: LightingLoadIntensity
properties.description: Average lighting load intensity in the space per unit area (PowerMeasure/IfcAreaMeasure)

properties.name: LightingPercentLoadToReturnAir
properties.description: Percent of lighting load to the return air plenum.

PSET_UTILITYCONSUMPTION.name: Pset_UtilityConsumption
PSET_UTILITYCONSUMPTION.description: Definition from IAI: Consumption of utility resources, typically applied to the IfcBuilding instance, used to identify how much was consumed on I.e., a monthly basis.

properties.name: Heat
properties.description: The amount of heat energy consumed during the period specified in the time series.

properties.name: Electricity
properties.description: The amount of electricity consumed during the period specified in the time series.

properties.name: Water
properties.description: The amount of water consumed during the period specified in the time series.

properties.name: Fuel
properties.description: The amount of fuel consumed during the period specified in the time series.

properties.name: Steam
properties.description: The amount of steam consumed during the period specified in the time series.

PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYANCHORBOLT.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryAnchorBolt
PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYANCHORBOLT.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to different types of anchor bolts.

properties.name: AnchorBoltLength
properties.description: The length of the anchor bolt.

properties.name: AnchorBoltDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter of the anchor bolt bar(s).

properties.name: AnchorBoltThreadLength
properties.description: The length of the threaded part of the anchor bolt.

properties.name: AnchorBoltProtrusionLength
properties.description: The length of the protruding part of the anchor bolt.

PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYCOLUMNSHOE.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryColumnShoe
PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYCOLUMNSHOE.description: Definition from IAI: Shape properties common to column shoes.

properties.name: ColumnShoeBasePlateThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the column shoe base plate.

properties.name: ColumnShoeBasePlateWidth
properties.description: The width of the column shoe base plate.

properties.name: ColumnShoeBasePlateDepth
properties.description: The depth of the column shoe base plate.

properties.name: ColumnShoeCasingHeight
properties.description: The height of the column shoe casing.

properties.name: ColumnShoeCasingWidth
properties.description: The width of the column shoe casing.

properties.name: ColumnShoeCasingDepth
properties.description: The depth of the column shoe casing.

PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYCORNERFIXINGPLATE.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryCornerFixingPlate
PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYCORNERFIXINGPLATE.description: Definition from IAI: Properties specific to corner fixing plates.

properties.name: CornerFixingPlateLength
properties.description: The length of the L-shaped corner plate.

properties.name: CornerFixingPlateThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the L-shaped corner plate.

properties.name: CornerFixingPlateFlangeWidthInPlaneZ
properties.description: The flange width of the L-shaped corner plate in plane Z.

properties.name: CornerFixingPlateFlangeWidthInPlaneX
properties.description: The flange width of the L-shaped corner plate in plane X.

PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYDIAGONALTRUSSCONNE.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryDiagonalTrussConnector
PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYDIAGONALTRUSSCONNE.description: Definition from IAI: Shape properties specific to connecting accessories in truss form with diagonal cross-bars.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussHeight
properties.description: The overall height of the truss connector.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussLength
properties.description: The overall length of the truss connector.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussCrossBarSpacing
properties.description: The spacing between diagonal cross-bar sections.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussBaseBarDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter of the base bar.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussSecondaryBarDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter of the secondary bar.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussCrossBarDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter of the diagonal cross-bars.

PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYEDGEFIXINGPLATE.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryEdgeFixingPlate
PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYEDGEFIXINGPLATE.description: Definition from IAI: Properties specific to edge fixing plates.

properties.name: EdgeFixingPlateLength
properties.description: The length of the L-shaped edge plate.

properties.name: EdgeFixingPlateThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the L-shaped edge plate.

properties.name: EdgeFixingPlateFlangeWidthInPlaneZ
properties.description: The flange width of the L-shaped edge plate in plane Z.

properties.name: EdgeFixingPlateFlangeWidthInPlaneX
properties.description: The flange width of the L-shaped edge plate in plane X.

PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYFIXINGSOCKET.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryFixingSocket
PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYFIXINGSOCKET.description: Definition from IAI: Properties common to fixing sockets.

properties.name: FixingSocketTypeReference
properties.description: Type reference for the fixing socket according to local standards.

properties.name: FixingSocketHeight
properties.description: The overall height of the fixing socket.

properties.name: FixingSocketThreadDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter of the thread.

properties.name: FixingSocketThreadLength
properties.description: The length of the threaded part of the fixing socket.

PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYLADDERTRUSSCONNECT.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryLadderTrussConnector
PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYLADDERTRUSSCONNECT.description: Definition from IAI: Shape properties specific to connecting accessories in truss form with straight cross-bars in ladder shape.

properties.name: LadderTrussHeight
properties.description: The overall height of the truss connector.

properties.name: LadderTrussLength
properties.description: The overall length of the truss connector.

properties.name: LadderTrussCrossBarSpacing
properties.description: The spacing between the straight cross-bars.

properties.name: LadderTrussBaseBarDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter of the base bar.

properties.name: LadderTrussSecondaryBarDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter of the secondary bar.

properties.name: LadderTrussCrossBarDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter of the straight cross-bars.

PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYSTANDARDFIXINGPLAT.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryStandardFixingPlate
PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYSTANDARDFIXINGPLAT.description: Definition from IAI: Properties specific to standard fixing plates.

properties.name: StandardFixingPlateWidth
properties.description: The width of the standard fixing plate.

properties.name: StandardFixingPlateDepth
properties.description: The depth of the standard fixing plate.

properties.name: StandardFixingPlateThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the standard fixing plate.

PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYWIRELOOP.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryWireLoop
PSET_DISCRETEACCESSORYWIRELOOP.description: Definition from IAI: Shape properties common to wire loop joint connectors.

properties.name: WireLoopBasePlateThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the base plate.

properties.name: WireLoopBasePlateWidth
properties.description: The width of the base plate.

properties.name: WireLoopBasePlateLength
properties.description: The length of the base plate.

properties.name: WireDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter of the wire.

properties.name: WireEmbeddingLength
properties.description: The length of the part of wire which is embedded in the precast concrete element.

properties.name: WireLoopLength
properties.description: The length of the fastening loop part of the wire.

PSET_ASSET.name: Pset_Asset
PSET_ASSET.description: Definition from IAI: An asset is a uniquely identifiable element which has a financial value and against which maintenance actions are recorded. \X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: AssetAccountingType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: AssetTaxType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of taxation group from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: AssetInsuranceType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of insurance rating from which the type required may be set.

PSET_FURNITURETYPECHAIR.name: Pset_FurnitureTypeChair
PSET_FURNITURETYPECHAIR.description: Definition from IAI: A set of specific properties for furniture type chair. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Chair\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: SeatingHeight
properties.description: The value of seating height if the chair height is not adjustable.

properties.name: HighestSeatingHeight
properties.description: The value of seating height of high level if the chair height is adjustable.

properties.name: LowestSeatingHeight
properties.description: The value of seating height of low level if the chair height is adjustable.

PSET_FURNITURETYPECOMMON.name: Pset_FurnitureTypeCommon
PSET_FURNITURETYPECOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Common properties for all types of furniture such as chair, desk, table, and file cabinet. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_FurnitureCommon

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Specific description of this type of furniture.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Description of the furniture style

properties.name: NominalHeight
properties.description: The nominal height of the furniture of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: NominalLength
properties.description: The nominal length of the furniture of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: NominalDepth
properties.description: The nominal depth of the furniture of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: MainColor
properties.description: The main color of the furniture of this type

PSET_FURNITURETYPEDESK.name: Pset_FurnitureTypeDesk
PSET_FURNITURETYPEDESK.description: Definition from IAI: A set of specific properties for furniture type desk. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Desk\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: WorksurfaceArea
properties.description: The value of the work surface area of the desk.

PSET_FURNITURETYPEFILECABINET.name: Pset_FurnitureTypeFileCabinet
PSET_FURNITURETYPEFILECABINET.description: Definition from IAI: A set of specific properties for furniture type file cabinet HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_FileCabinet\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: WithLock
properties.description: Indicates whether the file cabinet is lockable (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

PSET_FURNITURETYPETABLE.name: Pset_FurnitureTypeTable
PSET_FURNITURETYPETABLE.description: A set of specific properties for furniture type table. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Table\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: WorksurfaceArea
properties.description: The value of the work surface area of the desk..

properties.name: NumberOfChairs
properties.description: Maximum number of chairs that can fit with the table for normal use.

PSET_MANUFACTUREROCCURRENCE.name: Pset_ManufacturerOccurrence
PSET_MANUFACTUREROCCURRENCE.description: Definition from IAI: Defines properties of individual instances of manufactured products that may be given by the manufacturer.

properties.name: AcquisitionDate
properties.description: The date that the manufactured item was purchased.

properties.name: BarCode
properties.description: The identity of the bar code given to an occurrence of the product

properties.name: SerialNumber
properties.description: The serial number assigned to an occurrence of a product

properties.name: BatchReference
properties.description: The identity of the batch reference from which an occurrence of a product is taken.

PSET_MANUFACTURERTYPEINFORMATION.name: Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation
PSET_MANUFACTURERTYPEINFORMATION.description: Definition from IAI: Defines characteristics of manufactured products that may be given by the manufacturer. Note that the term 'manufactured' may also be used to refer to products that are supplied and identified by the supplier or that are assembled off site by a third party provider. \X2\000A\X0\This property set replaces the entity IfcManufacturerInformation from previous IFC releases.

properties.name: ArticleNumber
properties.description: Article number or reference that may be applied to a product according to a standard scheme for article number definition (e.g. UN, EAN)

properties.name: ModelReference
properties.description: The name of the manufactured item as used by the manufacturer.

properties.name: ModelLabel
properties.description: The model number and/or unit designator assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Manufacturer
properties.description: The organization that manufactured and/or assembled the item.

properties.name: ProductionYear
properties.description: The year of production of the manufactured item.

PSET_PROPERTYAGREEMENT.name: Pset_PropertyAgreement
PSET_PROPERTYAGREEMENT.description: Definition from IAI: A property agreement is an agreement that enables the occupation of a property for a period of time.\X2\000A000A\X0\The objective is to capture the information within an  agreement that is relevant to a facilities manager. Design and construction information associated with the property is not considered. A property agreement may be applied to an instance of IfcSpatialStructureElement including to compositions defined through the IfcSpatialStructureElement.Element.CompositionEnum.\X2\000A000A\X0\Note that the associated actors are captured by the IfcOccupant class.\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: AgreementType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of property agreement from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: Identifier
properties.description: The identifier assigned to the agreement for the purposes of tracking.

properties.name: Version
properties.description: The version number of the agreement that is identified

properties.name: VersionDate
properties.description: The date on which the version of the agreement became applicable

properties.name: PropertyName
properties.description: Addressing details of the property as stated within the agreement

properties.name: CommencementDate
properties.description: Date on which the agreement commences

properties.name: TerminationDate
properties.description: Date on which the agreement terminates

properties.name: Duration
properties.description: The period of time for the lease. Note that values should be given in year/day/month and not in hour/minute/second.

properties.name: Options
properties.description: A statement of the options available in the agreement

properties.name: ConditionCommencement
properties.description: Condition of property provided on commencement of the agreement e.g. cold shell, warm lit shell, broom clean, turn-key

properties.name: Restrictions
properties.description: Restrictions that may be placed by a  competent authority

properties.name: ConditionTermination
properties.description: Condition of property required on termination of the agreement e.g. cold shell, warm lit shell, broom clean, turn-key

PSET_RELIABILITY.name: Pset_Reliability
PSET_RELIABILITY.description: Definition from IAI: Indication of the expected reliability of a product\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: MeanTimeBetweenFailure
properties.description: The average time duration between instances of failure of a product.

PSET_RISK.name: Pset_Risk
PSET_RISK.description: Definition from IAI: An indication of exposure to mischance, peril, menace, hazard or loss. \X2\000A000A\X0\HISTORY: Extended in IFC2x3\X2\000A000A\X0\There are various types of risk that may be encountered and there may be several instances of Pset_Risk associated in an instance of an IfcObject (either a physical object, a grouping of physical objects such as an asset or a process).\X2\000A\X0\Specification of this property set incorporates the values of the Incom risk analysis matrix (satisfying AS/NZS 4360) together with additional identified requirements.\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: RiskType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: NatureOfRisk
properties.description: An indication of the generic nature of the risk that might be encountered. \X2\000A000A\X0\NOTE: It is anticipated that there will be a local agreement that constrains the values that might be assigned to this property. An example might be 'Fall'  or 'Fall of grille unit' causing injury and damage to person and property

properties.name: SubNatureOfRisk1
properties.description: A first subsidiary value that might be assigned to designate a more specific type of risk.\X2\000A000A\X0\NOTE: Nature of risk may be identified in various ways depending upon the place where risk assessment takes place and according to local agreement. This property set allows for a generic nature of risk and up to two subsidiary natures. An example might be 'causing injury and damage'

properties.name: SubNatureOfRisk2
properties.description: A second subsidiary value that might be assigned to designate a more specific type of risk. An example might be 'o person and property'

properties.name: RiskCause
properties.description: A value that may be assigned to capture the cause or trigger for the risk. An example might be 'poor fixing'

properties.name: AssessmentOfRisk
properties.description: Likelihood of risk event occurring.\X2\000A000A\X0\Note  that assessment of risk may frequently be associated with the physical location of the object for which the risk is assessed.

properties.name: RiskConsequence
properties.description: Indicates the level of severity of the consequences that the risk would have in case it happens

properties.name: RiskRating
properties.description: A general rating of the risk that may be determined from a combination of the risk assessment and risk consequence

properties.name: RiskOwner
properties.description: A determination of who is the owner of the risk by reference to principal roles of organizations within a project. Determination of the specific organization should be by reference to instances of IfcActorRole assigned to instances of IfcOrganization (if assigned).

properties.name: AffectsSurroundings
properties.description: Indicates wether the risk affects only to the person assigned to that task (FALSE) or if it can also affect to the people in the surroundings (TRUE).\X2\000A000A\X0\For example, the process of painting would affect all the people in the vicinity of the process

properties.name: PreventiveMeassures
properties.description: Identifies preventive measures to be taken to mitigate risk

PSET_SYSTEMFURNITUREELEMENTTYPECOMMON.name: Pset_SystemFurnitureElementTypeCommon
PSET_SYSTEMFURNITUREELEMENTTYPECOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Common properties for all systems furniture (I.e. modular furniture) element types (e.g. vertical panels, work surfaces, and storage). HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_FurnitureElementCommon

properties.name: IsUsed
properties.description: Indicates whether the element is being used in a workstation (= TRUE) or not.(= FALSE).

properties.name: GroupCode
properties.description: e.g. panels, worksurfaces, storage, etc.

properties.name: NominalWidth
properties.description: The nominal width of the system furniture elements of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: NominalHeight
properties.description: The nominal height of the system furniture elements of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: Finishing
properties.description: The finishing applied to system furniture elements of this type e.g. walnut, fabric.

PSET_SYSTEMFURNITUREELEMENTTYPEPANEL.name: Pset_SystemFurnitureElementTypePanel
PSET_SYSTEMFURNITUREELEMENTTYPEPANEL.description: Definition from IAI: A set of specific properties for vertical panels that assembly workstations.. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Panel

properties.name: HasOpening
properties.description: indicates whether the panel has an opening (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: FurniturePanelType
properties.description: Available panel types from which that required may be selected.

properties.name: NominalThickness
properties.description: The nominal thickness of the panel

PSET_SYSTEMFURNITUREELEMENTTYPEWORKSURFA.name: Pset_SystemFurnitureElementTypeWorkSurface
PSET_SYSTEMFURNITUREELEMENTTYPEWORKSURFA.description: Definition from IAI: A set of specific properties for work surfaces used in workstations. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Worksurface

properties.name: UsePurpose
properties.description: The principal purpose for which the work surface is intended to be used e.g. writing/reading, computer, meeting, printer, reference files, etc.

properties.name: SupportType
properties.description: Available support types from which that required may be selected.

properties.name: HangingHeight
properties.description: The hanging height of the worksurface.

properties.name: NominalThickness
properties.description: The nominal thickness of the work surface.

properties.name: ShapeDescription
properties.description: A description of the shape of the work surface e.g. corner square, rectangle, etc.

PSET_WARRANTY.name: Pset_Warranty
PSET_WARRANTY.description: Definition from IAI: An assurance given by the seller or provider of an artefact that the artefact is without defects and will operate as described for a defined period of time without failure and that if a defect does arise during that time, that it will be corrected by the seller or provider.\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: WarrantyIdentifier
properties.description: The identifier assigned to a warranty.

properties.name: WarrantyStartDate
properties.description: The date on which the warranty commences

properties.name: WarrantyEndDate
properties.description: The date on which the warranty expires.

properties.name: IsExtendedWarranty
properties.description: Indication of whether this is an extended warranty whose duration is greater than that normally assigned to an artefact (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE)

properties.name: WarrantyPeriod
properties.description: The time duration during which a manufacturer or supplier guarantees or warrants the performance of an artefact.

properties.name: PointOfContact
properties.description: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

properties.name: WarrantyContent
properties.description: The content of the warranty

properties.name: Exclusions
properties.description: Items, conditions or actions that may be excluded from the warranty or that may cause the warranty to become void.

PSET_PROJECTORDERCHANGEORDER.name: Pset_ProjectOrderChangeOrder
PSET_PROJECTORDERCHANGEORDER.description: Definition from IAI: A change order is an instruction to make a change to a product or work being undertake. Note that the change order status is defined in the same way as a work order status since a change order implies a work requirement.\X2\000A\X0\

properties.name: ChangeDescription
properties.description: A general description of the change.

properties.name: ReasonForChange

PSET_PROJECTORDERMAINTENANCEWORKORDER.name: Pset_ProjectOrderMaintenanceWorkOrder
PSET_PROJECTORDERMAINTENANCEWORKORDER.description: Definition from IAI: A MaintenanceWorkOrder is a detailed description of maintenance work that is to be performed. properties.name: MaintenaceType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of maintenance that can be done from which the type that generates the maintenance work order may be set where:\X2\000A000A\X0\ConditionBased = generated as a result of the condition of an asset or artefact being less than a determined value.\X2\000A\X0\Corrective = generated as a result of an immediate and urgent need for maintenance action.\X2\000A\X0\PlannedCorrective = generated as a result of immediate corrective action being needed but with sufficient time available for the work order to be included in maintenance planning.\X2\000A\X0\Scheduled = generated as a result of a fixed, periodic maintenance requirement.

properties.name: FaultPriorityType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of priority that can be assigned from which the type may be set where:\X2\000A000A\X0\High = action is required urgently.\X2\000A\X0\Medium = action can occur within a reasonable period of time.\X2\000A\X0\Low = action can occur when convenient.

PSET_CONCRETEELEMENTGENERAL.name: Pset_ConcreteElementGeneral
PSET_CONCRETEELEMENTGENERAL.description: Definition from IAI: General properties common to different types of concrete elements. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement.

properties.name: StructuralClass
properties.description: The structural class defined for the concrete structure (e.g. '1').

properties.name: EnvironmentalClass
properties.description: The environmental class for the concrete structure (e.g. 'Y1')

properties.name: FireRating
properties.description: Fire rating given according to the national fire safety classification

properties.name: ServiceLife
properties.description: Expected service life (usually measured in years)

properties.name: LifeCycleEnvironmentalLoad
properties.description: Description of the life-cycle environmental load

properties.name: DimensionalAccuracyClass
properties.description: Classification designation of the dimensional accuracy requirement according to local standards.

properties.name: ConstructionToleranceClass
properties.description: Classification designation of the on-site construction tolerances according to local standards.

properties.name: ConstructionType
properties.description: Designator for whether the concrete element is constructed on site or prefabricated. Allowed values are: 'Insitu' vs 'Precast'

properties.name: ConcreteCoverAtMainBars
properties.description: The protective concrete cover at the main reinforcing bars according to local building regulations.

properties.name: ConcreteCoverAtLinks
properties.description: The protective concrete cover at the reinforcement links according to local building regulations.

PSET_CONCRETEELEMENTQUANTITYGENERAL.name: Pset_ConcreteElementQuantityGeneral
PSET_CONCRETEELEMENTQUANTITYGENERAL.description: Definition from IAI: Bill-of-Quantity properties common to different types of precast concrete elements. The Pset is used to express the total bulk quantities per element. The quantities may include the concrete, reinforcement, and different kinds of accessories. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement. Note: Bulk quantities for parts used for surface finish, tiles, bricks, etc. are included as area quantities in Pset_ConcreteElementSurfaceFinishQuantityGeneral.

properties.name: TotalConcreteQuantity
properties.description: The total bulk quantity of concrete used for the precast concrete element expressed as the volume of concrete in cubic meter (m3).

PSET_CONCRETEELEMENTSURFACEFINISHQUANTIT.name: Pset_ConcreteElementSurfaceFinishQuantityGeneral
PSET_CONCRETEELEMENTSURFACEFINISHQUANTIT.description: Definition from IAI: Surface finish related properties common to different types of concrete elements. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement, like IfcBeam, IfcColumn, IfcWall, etc. If a precast concrete element is a sandwich wall panel each structural layer or shell represented by an IfcBuildingElementPart may be attached to a separate Pset.The surface finishes are expressed as area quantities only for each surface finish type. The exact details (location, area shape, overlaps, tile joints, patterns, etc.) of the surface finishes are expressed in external documents using the IfcDocumentReference mechanism. Each of the defined properties are instantiated as needed, and multiple instantiations of the same property for each different surface classification are possible.

properties.name: SurfaceDescriptionDocReference
properties.description: Reference to an external document describing the details of the surface of the concrete element, i.e. a drawing or textual document file.

PSET_PRECASTCONCRETEELEMENTGENERAL.name: Pset_PrecastConcreteElementGeneral
PSET_PRECASTCONCRETEELEMENTGENERAL.description: Definition from IAI: Production and manufacturing related properties common to different types of precast concrete elements. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement. If the precast concrete element is a sandwich wall panel each structural layer or shell represented by an IfcBuildingElementPart may be attached to a separate Pset of this type, if needed. Some of the properties apply only for specific types of precast concrete elements.

properties.name: TypeDesignator
properties.description: Type designator for the precast concrete element. The content depends on local standards. For instance in Finland it usually a one-letter acronym, e.g. P=Column, K=reinforced concrete beam,etc.

properties.name: ProductionLotId
properties.description: The manufacturer's production lot identifier.

properties.name: SerialNumber
properties.description: The manufacturer's serial number for the precast concrete element.

properties.name: ElementWeight
properties.description: The weight of the concrete element. Usually expressed in kg.

properties.name: ElementGrossVolume
properties.description: The gross volume of concrete element. Usually expressed in cubic metre (m3).

properties.name: ElementNetVolume
properties.description: The net volume of concrete element. Openings, voids, chamfers, etc. are subtracted from the gross volume. Usually expressed in cubic metre (m3).

properties.name: CornerChamfer
properties.description: The chamfer in the corners of the precast element. The chamfer is presumed to be equal in both directions.

properties.name: ManufacturingToleranceClass
properties.description: Classification designation of the manufacturing tolerances according to local standards.

properties.name: FormStrippingStrength
properties.description: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete at form stripping time.

properties.name: LiftingStrength
properties.description: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete when the concrete element is lifted.

properties.name: ReleaseStrength
properties.description: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete when the tendon stress is released. This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

properties.name: MinimumAllowableSupportLength
properties.description: The minimum allowable support length.

properties.name: InitialTension
properties.description: The initial stress of the tendon. This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

properties.name: TendonRelaxation
properties.description: The maximum allowable relaxation of the tendon (usually expressed as %/1000 h).This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

properties.name: TransportationStrength
properties.description: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete required for transportation.

properties.name: SupportDuringTransportDescription
properties.description: Textual description of how the concrete element is supported during transportation

properties.name: SupportDuringTransportDocReference
properties.description: Reference to an external document defining how the concrete element is supported during transportation

properties.name: HollowCorePlugging
properties.description: A descriptive label for how the hollow core ends are treated: they may be left open, closed with a plug, or sealed with cast concrete. Values would be, for example: 'Unplugged', 'Plugged', 'SealedWithConcrete'. This property applies to  hollow core slabs only.

PSET_REINFORCEMENTBARCOUNTOFINDEPENDENTF.description: Definition from IAI: Reinforcement Concrete parameter [ST-2]: The amount number information of reinforcement  bar with the independent footing. The X and Y direction are based on the local coordinate system of building storey. The X and Y direction of the reinforcement bar are parallel to the X and Y axis of the IfcBuildingStorey's local coordinate system, respectively.

PSET_REINFORCINGBARBENDINGSBECCOMMON.name: Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsBECCommon
PSET_REINFORCINGBARBENDINGSBECCOMMON.description: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are defined according to the local Finnish BEC standard with minor adjustements (only bar bending information is included). The bending shape property definitions apply to both reinforcing bars (IfcReinforcingBar) and reinforcing meshes (IfcReinforcingMesh). It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism.

properties.description: The bending type code for the specific bending shape as defined in the BEC standard. Note: depending on the standardized shape different combinations of following parameters a...e (f...l), TD, u, v, u1, v1, aid_x, and aid_y are used.

PSET_REINFORCINGBARBENDINGSDIN135610COMM.name: Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsDIN135610Common
PSET_REINFORCINGBARBENDINGSDIN135610COMM.description: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are largely defined according to DIN 1356 Teil 10 with some minor omissions: the shape type X2 is not considered since it is better represented by the explicit shape geometry. It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism. Note: This bending standard is presumably to be replaced by the upcoming ISO 3766 standard.

properties.name: DIN135610ShapeCode
properties.description: The bending type code for the specific bending shape as defined in the DIN 1356 Teil 10 standard. Note: depending on the standardized shape different combinations of following parameters a...z are used.

properties.name: DIN135610ShapeParameter_a
properties.description: Bar shape parameter a. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter a0 (shape code B3)

properties.name: DIN135610ShapeParameter_b
properties.description: Bar shape parameter b. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter b0 (shape codes C2 and C3)

properties.name: DIN135610ShapeParameter_c
properties.description: Bar shape parameter c.

properties.name: DIN135610ShapeParameter_d
properties.description: Bar shape parameter d. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter d0 (shape code B3)

properties.name: DIN135610ShapeParameter_e
properties.description: Bar shape parameter e. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter e0 (shape codes A4 and C3)

properties.name: DIN135610ShapeParameter_z
properties.description: Bar shape parameter z.

PSET_REINFORCINGBARBENDINGSISOCD3766COMM.name: Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsISOCD3766Common
PSET_REINFORCINGBARBENDINGSISOCD3766COMM.description: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are largely defined according to ISO/CD 3766 with some minor changes in how the hooks are defined (explicit angle measures instead of coded parameters). It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism. Note: This standard is still under development and the Pset will be changed accordingly if so required.

properties.name: ISOCD3766ShapeCode
properties.description: The bending type code for the specific bending shape as defined in the ISO/CD 3766 standard. Note: depending on the standardized shape different combinations of following parameters a...e and R are used.

properties.name: ISOCD3766ShapeParameter_a
properties.description: Bar shape parameter a.

properties.name: ISOCD3766ShapeParameter_b
properties.description: Bar shape parameter b.

properties.name: ISOCD3766ShapeParameter_c
properties.description: Bar shape parameter c.

properties.name: ISOCD3766ShapeParameter_d
properties.description: Bar shape parameter d.

properties.name: ISOCD3766ShapeParameter_e
properties.description: Bar shape parameter e.

properties.name: ISOCD3766ShapeParameter_R
properties.description: Bar shape parameter R. Used for bending radius.

properties.name: ISOCD3766BendingStartHook
properties.description: The angle of the hook at start of the bar. If the property is not included the bar has no start hook. Note: this differs from how ISO/CD 3766 handles end hooks.

properties.name: ISOCD3766BendingEndHook
properties.description: The angle of the hook at end of the bar. If the property is not included  the bar has no end hook. Note: this differs from how ISO/CD 3766 handles end hooks.
